audience: e-commerce sellers and small shippers who book courier parcels with Interparcel

useCases.title: Track a parcel by its tracking number
useCases.text: Give the 12-digit tracking number. The assistant reads the current tracking events and says where the parcel is.

useCases.title: Compare courier prices before you book
useCases.text: Enter the parcels and both addresses. The assistant lists the priced services and pickup dates. Nothing is booked or paid.

useCases.title: Find shipments on hold and read their errors
useCases.text: Search Shipping Manager by status, dates or reference. Open one shipment to see its validation errors before you book it.

useCases.title: Check an order and the PrePay balance
useCases.text: Read the status and tracking numbers of a booked order. Check the PrePay balance and the saved cards before you book more couriers.

useCases.title: Book courier orders from a quote
useCases.text: Use the service and pickup date from a quote. The assistant books 1 to 20 paid courier orders with a saved card or PrePay. Each order is a paid job.

useCases.title: Import shipments for later booking
useCases.text: Add a shipment to Shipping Manager for later booking. The import takes no payment and books no courier.
